content_payload.title: BakingDesk
content_payload.subtitle: Integrated Project I
content_payload.lead: My first integrated coursework project. I developed most of the backend and proposed the design. It challenged me both academically and personally, and it remains a project I care deeply about.

content_payload.heading: What is BakingDesk?
content_payload.text:
BakingDesk is a full-stack bakery management system designed to streamline daily operations for small bakeries. From inventory tracking to order management, the application covers the core needs of a bakery business in a clean, intuitive interface.

This was my first integrated project for my university coursework — a project where I had to combine everything I had learned about backend development, database design, and frontend implementation into a single, cohesive product. I took the lead on backend architecture and proposed the visual design direction for the team.

phases.title: Planning & Research
phases.desc: Defined the project scope, researched bakery workflows, designed the 3NF relational database schema, and created initial wireframes for the user interface.

phases.title: Backend Architecture
phases.desc: Built the server-side logic, REST API endpoints with Java & Javalin, database connections, and authentication system. This was the core of my contribution to the team.

phases.title: Frontend & Design
phases.desc: Proposed and implemented the visual design direction. Connected the frontend with backend APIs and ensured a smooth user experience across the application.

phases.title: Testing & Delivery
phases.desc: Final testing, bug fixes, documentation, and project presentation. Successfully delivered as a complete, functional system.

content_payload.heading: Transactional Order Pipeline.

cards.title: Backend Architecture
cards.text: Learning to structure a real backend from scratch — handling routes, controllers, and database queries in a way that actually scales was one of the biggest hurdles I faced.

cards.title: Team Collaboration
cards.text: Working in a team taught me how to communicate technical decisions, manage code conflicts, and align everyone toward a shared vision — skills that go beyond just writing code.

cards.title: Design Decisions
cards.text: Proposing the design for the whole team was nerve-wracking. I had to balance aesthetics with usability and make sure the interface was intuitive for real bakery workflows.
